b11: The Baja 1000 doesn't always run the same course.
Since 2000, eleven of its twenty-six races have run point to point,
from one city to another, instead of a loop.
In 2023, it ran from La Paz back to Ensenada: one thousand three hundred ten point nine miles.
The 2026 race starts and finishes at Los Cabos, as one loop, on November ninth.
The official distance is still to be announced. Every Baja 1000 winner since 1967 is on race dot M X.
